summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing the detailed final voting map from its Ordinary General Meeting held on April 29, 2026. The filing is a routine post-meeting disclosure required under CVM Resolution No. 81/22, providing a breakdown of shareholder votes on items such as the financial statements and management accounts. There is no special-situation catalyst; it merely fulfills regulatory reporting obligations for a foreign private issuer. No special situation.
